title: Been going to “Mallworld” every night for years
content: Sometimes I start in the city, sometimes I’m traveling to the city. I go to parties with everyone I know and more randoms, I ride through the streets in the suburbs on a bike, I hike through nature and nature parks; nearly every dream I’m rock hounding crystals out of a river. (I have a crystal collection irl and am always fiending for more) Sometimes I’m at a beach with Caribbean blue water by the city. Sometimes, I’m downtown and it’s bustling and colorful and busy and the buildings are very tall. I visit airports and train stations and theatres and old abandoned houses and houses with rooms leading to other rooms endlessly, and crazy maze like factory warehouses, like an Amazon fulfillment center if you’ve ever been in one. A lot of times I’m in a school that’s a mixture of my old school and a bigger, better one haha. I also go to the abandoned quarter, like Detroit but it’s peaceful and overgrown like it’s been abandoned for 500 years. Tall buildings are just husks and walls with heavy flora. I also often go to grocery stores with a huge bakery and eat sweets, probably bc I constantly crave cookies and shit when awake lmao. My mallworld seems to be an entire realm, and I visit every single night without fail and have various adventures. I almost like sleeping better than reality.
